purpose: Five new source-only human/hand-action official tasks: clothing-color2 and style/prop3; compare same-P1 Native versus fixed routing.

source_event_annotations: Evaluation-only source observations. No hand-marked action window enters model or router.
cost: Record20NFE/20callbacks/1000blocks; Native0/ON450 routed blocks; capture time separate; no online observer.

evaluation.official: Pinned IVEBench Motion Fidelity on original valid physical prefix after fixed16/8 padding crop

evaluation.visibility_policy: short0131 both workers retain their respective motions and roles; short0321 added bouquet can validly occlude a hand. Record visible/unobservable/legally occluded events separately; never infer an omitted action solely from occlusion. All five remain in fixed denominator.
